title: Beach & Rainforest Sanctuary
tagline: Where prehistoric rainforest greets the warm South China Sea.
description: Santubong is where myth meets nature. Walk pristine golden sand shorelines, hike the foothills of Mount Santubong surrounded by hornbills and ancient flora, and drift into coastal sunset bliss at Damai Beach and Damai Lagoon.

title: Eden Damai Wellness
tagline: Holistic coastal healing inspired by Borneo's sacred botanical wisdom.
description: Surrender to therapeutic hydrotherapy, oceanfront yoga pavilions, and bespoke massage rituals utilizing indigenous wild ginger, virgin coconut oils, and Bario mineral salts at Eden Damai Wellness.

title: Gastronomic Heritage & Sky Dining
tagline: From authentic Macanese heritage to 18th-floor rooftop panoramas.
description: Sarawak is Malaysia's first UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy. Journey through Halal Cantonese dim sum at Macau Restaurant, freshly harvested seafood at Cafe Satang, and elevated modern European fusion at Suasana on 18.
highlights: Signature Sarawak Laksa with sea prawns

title: Borneo Culture & Riverfront Heritage
tagline: Step from our grand lobbies directly into Sarawak's living history.
description: Stroll the iconic Kuching Waterfront esplanade, visit the architectural marvel of Borneo Cultures Museum, explore colonial Fort Margherita, or experience the indigenous traditions of the Sarawak Cultural Village.

title: MICE & Grand Celebrations
tagline: The premier stage for international summits and fairytale weddings in Sarawak.
description: With Sarawak's largest hotel ballrooms accommodating up to 1,200 delegates alongside beachfront romantic wedding pavilions, Hemisphere delivers flawless execution and gracious hospitality.
